We want you to shop with confidence at Fragal Perfumes. If you're not satisfied, we're here to help.

Return Eligibility:

  • Returns are accepted within 15 days of delivery.
  • The product must have at least 90% remaining, in its original condition and packaging.

Return Process:

  • To request a return, WhatsApp us at +92 308 4456947.
  • Our team will assist you step by step.
  • Returns are processed within 7 working days after approval.

Refund Details:

  • Delivery charges from the original order are non-refundable.
  • Refunds will be issued to your bank account after the returned product has been inspected.
  • In case of a damaged, leaked or wrong product, you get a full refund including delivery charges.
